  SELECT w.Fielders AS Player_Id, COUNT(*) AS catch_count
  FROM Wicket_Taken AS w
  JOIN Out_Type AS o ON o.Out_Id = w.Kind_Out
  WHERE o.Out_Name = 'caught' AND w.Fielders IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY w.Fielders
), average_catches AS (
  SELECT CAST(COUNT(w.Fielders) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(Player_Id) FROM Player) AS avg_count
  FROM Wicket_Taken AS w
  JOIN Out_Type AS o ON o.Out_Id = w.Kind_Out
  WHERE o.Out_Name = 'caught' AND w.Fielders IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.Player_Name, c.Country_Name
FROM catches AS ca
JOIN Player AS p ON p.Player_Id = ca.Player_Id
JOIN Country AS c ON c.Country_Id = p.Country_Name
CROSS JOIN average_catches AS a
WHERE ca.catch_count > a.avg_count
ORDER BY ca.catch_count ASC;
